eventDetail.about: Communication, Networking and Broadcast Technologies; Signal Processing and Analysis
eventDetail.keywords: Communication, Technology, LTE, Wireless Communication, Communication Theory, Signal Processing,
eventDetail.scope: The conference is concerned with current and emerging research in communication theory. Topics of interest include: analysis and optimization of communication skills, wireless communication technologies, signal processing for communications, estimation and detection, industrial applications of communication theory, and applications of communication theory to non-traditional fields (biology or finance)
